bestBets.overview: Track rated heavy 9 at time of acceptances and according to the weather bureau, there is a possibility of further showers leading up to the meeting. NOAH'S ARK made a mess of the start here on debut before running on well to finish third to Scootathewoota. He's likely to have taken benefit from that run. DIVERGENT will find this easier than the race she contested at Pakenham last time. STRONG MINDED has hit the line well at his past two starts, finishing second to Xitan last time. SHE'S ICONNIC was good behind Shivouac when resuming, then only battled in Saturday company last start. CHAPPA and OAK PARK MOLLY are others worth considering.

raceTips.comment: Noah's Ark had specking and should have won on debut beaten when 3rd behind Scootathewoota. He draws out but should be giving this a shake. Strong Minded was placed at Balaklava two runs back and then ran well again running 2nd behind Xitan at Strathalbyn last time. She's Iconic was very good first-up from a break running 2nd behind Shivouac at Morphettville and battled behind Amalfi Dream on the Parks last time. Divergent makes hi SA debut and has shown ability.

bestBets.overview: DIRTY DEAL made good ground from back in the field to finish third to Paringa at Strathalbyn when rising in distance. He got through the wet conditions okay that day and looks suited here. TASSORO made steady ground to finish fifth behind Goodlookin' Guru this route last week. He was runner-up to Paganini the start prior. KARMA QUEEN has been around the mark at her past couple of runs although there haven't been any excuses for her. RESILIENT RUBY was not disgraced when midfield at Balaklava on debut in June. She has since been freshened. A TIME TO KILL and KHORASAN are others with claims.

raceTips.comment: Dirty Deal showed improvement when 3rd behind Paringa at Strathalbyn. He draws out and the rise again in trip should be ideal. Khorasan was solid in the market and ran well after covering ground when 4th behind Xitan at Strathalbyn. Karma Queen was runner-up here two runs back behind Summertime Madness and then followed up with another solid effort beaten 0.97 lengths in 4th behind Scootathewoota. Rich Melody wasn’t beaten far in that race. A Time To Kill looked to have his chance behind Goodlookin' Guru here last week.

bestBets.overview: AMICAL got up right on the line to win his maiden here two starts ago. He was sent out a big price in the Lightning Stakes last time and performed accordingly. Expecting him to improve sharply back in this grade. SCOOTATHEWOOTA came from behind the speed to defeat Brazen Queen here three weeks ago. He'll carry 59kg after Alysha Warren's claim. ILLUSTRATES has performed well in both runs back from a break and should not be overlooked. LOTS OF TORQUE got through the heavy going well to win at Naracoorte at her third run back from a break. CHIP'N'DALE and LUNARSHOT have minor claims.

raceTips.comment: Amical was a good winner here two runs back and then jumped to Listed level and caught the eye late when 6th behind Cavalry Girl at Morphettville. Tully Hart broke her maiden winning a metro 2yo race here on Jul 4 and then forget she went around last time. Illustrates was a good Balaklava maiden winner two runs back and then narrowly beaten behind Zenacity at Strathalbyn. No Mans Land won a Gawler maiden on debut on a Heavy track. Chip'n'Dale won winning his maiden at Albury last time and draws out. Scootathewoota was won his maiden here last time.

bestBets.overview: TERRITORIAN has finished in the placings at his past couple of runs and looks close to a win. Jacop Opperman takes the ride today. ZENACITY ran home well to land the prize at Strathalbyn last time. This is no harder, but she has to carry 2.5kg more. IRONBAR looked good winning this route two starts ago. He went to Naracoorte last time where he only beat one home but I'm inclined to give him another chance. LAST WAR made good ground from back in the field to finish just behind the placegetters at Balaklava last time. SHALHAVMUSIK and FASHION DOG look best of the rest.

raceTips.comment: Zenacity was good here two runs back running 3rd behind Meg's Magic and found winning form at Strathalbyn beating Illustrates. Territorian was runner-up behind Charlesfort at Bordertown two runs back and then good here when 3rd behind Justica's Bonus last time. Ironbar was a winner here two runs back and then well beaten at Naracoorte. Fashion Dog was OK here in the Justica's Bonus race two runs back. City Gold Ready is a former NSW galloper making his local debut.

bestBets.overview: TAUPO TIGER was having his first run for almost five weeks when he got tired late at Strathalbyn. He got the money on a heavy track the start prior. TAKE A PICK ran home well from the tail of the field to finish fourth behind Collated last week. The step up in distance is in his favour here. CHANCE TAKEN has been close-up in the finish in recent runs. Blinkers come off and visors go on for the first time. EAGLELOU didn't have the best of luck when placed behind Star Studded Belle at Balaklava last month. IRLANDAIS has been runner-up at his past two starts, the latest at Hamilton on 1/8.

raceTips.comment: Chartin was well backed here three runs back and didn’t have a lot of luck when 3rd behind Devine Fire at Strathalbyn last time. Chance Taken was good here two runs back running 2nd behind Petit Eagle and then 5th behind Star Studded Belle at Balaklava. Eaglelou has a win and two placings from six runs here. Taupo Tiger was a Wodonga winner two runs back. I Love This Song was a Bordertown winner three starts back. Take a Pick and stablemate I Am Ralph can run well.
